synopsis: The glossary describes Fraunhofer ITWM VMC Road & Scene-Generator as building scenes from fused real measurements; Chapter 11 specifies 3D scenes for camera, lidar and radar simulation using real data sources and the REDAR measurement vehicle [f16000, f8612, f9173]. Chapter 11 lists it among environment creation and reconstruction offerings and identifies its delivery model as research and service [f8359, f9172]. Heavy-machine deployment detail was not found on the reviewed page, so the documented scene-generation capability does not establish suitability for heavy-machine deployment [f8613, f9174]. Interfaces and standards were not verified, and neither a public price nor a latest release was found, leaving integration, cost and release status unresolved [f9175, f9176, f9177].

relations.note: Adds 3D output, simulated sensor types and the REDAR measurement vehicle.
Specifies that real-data scenes are built from fused measurements.
Details the real-data scene-generation process and sensor simulation scope.
Both report missing heavy-machine deployment detail.
Scene-generation capabilities support inclusion among environment creation and reconstruction offerings.
